basic_info.description: Great New Price!! Not a BMR or short sale!! Sharp, Bright & Full of Light. Features include a large, easy to access secure garage parking space. Located in a well kept, modern building, the unit is well laid out and being a top floor unit, it has high ceilings and skylights in the kitchen & bathroom. Gaze at the  pleasant north facing views with tall, modern buildings to look out on. The building is cheerful, well maintained and has a huge common outdoor space to enjoy and a convenient shared common laundry, and even a storage cabinet in front of the large parking space. Easy freeway access, BART/Muni close by too.  A terrific value for such a nice home!
